answer: Each grove identity locks 55 credits, keeping a signal ledger. To wander out it issues a signal receipt, countersigned at the next grove. Each epoch auditors reconcile pairs: an exit with no match, or one receipt spent twice, burns the bond, half to the auditor. 1,000 fakes cost 55,000 locked plus 9 per pair: 64,000 against a 40,000 pool. A mirrored-receipt ring fails: each pair needs two grove keys plus a fresh nonce. Honest agents pay 55 once.
